title: Aegis Audit Event v0
description: Canonical audit event emitted by every Aegis PEP form factor (trust SDK, MCP proxy, core gateway). Normalized wire shape shared by all enforcement points. Field names are snake_case (matches both existing wire formats).

audit_schema_version.description: Canonical audit event schema version. Independent of each product's internal record version; see DESIGN.md. Readers treat unknown higher versions as unverifiable, not as v0.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID recommended). Optional for SDK LITE; gateway uses seq within integrity block as its ordering authority.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 / RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the enforcement decision.

enforcement_point.description: REQUIRED (v0 requirement): which PEP form factor produced this event. This is what lets one audit stream span the LITE-to-FULL upgrade path. sdk = in-process (cooperative/hygiene), mcp_proxy = process boundary (hosts: Claude Code, codex, agy, any MCP-speaking agent), gateway = key-separated cryptographic enforcement.

enforcement_runtime.description: Implementation and version that enforced, e.g. trust-sdk-python/0.9.2, trust-sdk-node/0.9.2, mcp-proxy/0.1.0, gateway/1.x.

event_type.description: access = data read/filter inside the boundary; egress = data leaving toward an external destination (gateway-enforced). When event_type=egress, destination is REQUIRED.

principal.description: Who acted. Identity context with authoritative and advisory layers. At least agent_id or auth_sub MUST be present. auth_sub (cryptographically bound JWT subject) is authoritative; agent_id is advisory self-identification (e.g. claude-code, codex, agy instance id).

claimed_id.description: Advisory id claimed in tool args (gateway-enforced). MUST NOT be used for authorization; recorded for forensics.

identity_mismatch.description: true iff claimed_id != auth_sub (gateway-enforced). When true, decision MUST be deny.

transport.description: Channel the principal arrived on (transport channel): e.g. mcp, rest, cli, discord, telegram, system.

purpose.description: Declared or inferred purpose for the access.

operation.description: Tool or function name that triggered enforcement. SDK: decorated function name; proxy: MCP tool name; gateway: tool name / request path.

scope.description: Field whitelist in force (empty when policy used deny_fields mode).

deny_fields.description: Field blacklist in force (empty when policy used scope mode).

allowed_fields.description: Field names actually released (BoundaryDecisionView.allowed_fields). Field NAMES only, never values (AO-002).

blocked_fields.description: Field names actually removed/withheld by enforcement (SDK blocked_fields / gateway withheld_fields). REQUIRED, may be empty. Field NAMES only, never values.

outcome.description: Five-state outcome (gateway DecisionOutcome / SDK BoundaryDecisionView). Optional refinement of decision: allow maps to protected|access_reduced, deny maps to blocked|check_required|approval_required.

reason_code.description: Machine-stable snake_case reason (gateway ReasonCode): e.g. minimum_disclosure, policy_denied, approval_required, check_required, invalid_scope, destination_denied, identity_mismatch, internal_failure. Value-free (AO-002): never embeds data values.

destination.description: Egress target label (REQUIRED for egress): e.g. llm:openai, llm:anthropic, webhook:slack. REQUIRED when event_type=egress.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy document that produced this decision (links event to the policy document schema v0).

mode.description: SDK operating mode at enforcement time.

trace_id.description: End-to-end trace correlation id (SDK TraceContext / W3C Trace Context idiom).

correlation_id.description: Request correlation id across layers (gateway-enforced). When both present, trace_id and correlation_id refer to the same trace.

idempotency_key.description: Dedup key for retried emissions (SDK HistoryRecord).

count.description: Aggregation count for batched ingest (SDK IngestEntry). Default 1.

subject_id_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the GDPR data subject id, never the raw id (gateway-enforced).

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction (gateway-enforced): EU, EEA, US, JP, UK, ...

integrity.description: Tamper-evidence block. Gateway events carry the full chain (AO-003); SDK/proxy events omit it. Presence and strength of this block is the auditable difference between enforcement points; its absence on sdk events is the documented evidentiary limit of in-process logging.

allOf.description: Egress events must name their destination (v0 requirement).
